exam: 2023年6月 第3套 · 仔细阅读 P2
title: There are close to 58,000 homeless people in Los Angeles cou…

sents.en: There are close to 58,000 homeless people in Los Angeles county.
sents.cn: 洛杉矶县有近58,000名无家可归者。

sents.en: That's a shocking and tragic number for a region that's home to some of the richest people in the world.
sents.cn: 对于一个居住着一些世界首富的地区来说，这是一个令人震惊的悲惨数字。

sents.en: At last, the problem became so acute·and so visible·that Los Angeles took extraordinary action.
sents.cn: 最终，这个问题变得如此尖锐——如此显眼——以至于洛杉矶采取了非同寻常的行动。

sents.en: The citizens of this county voted in November 2016 and again in March 2017 to raise their own taxes.
sents.cn: 该县居民在2016年11月、随后又在2017年3月投票决定给自己加税。

sents.en: The purpose of such action is to fund an enormous multibillion-dollar, 10-year program of housing and social services for the homeless.
sents.cn: 此举的目的是为一项面向无家可归者的巨额住房与社会服务计划提供资金——该项目耗资数十亿美元，为期10年。

sents.en: As a result, Los Angeles now has its best chance in decades to combat homelessness.
sents.cn: 这样一来，洛杉矶如今拥有了数十年来打击无家可归现象的最佳机会。

sents.en: This is an opportunity that surely all can agree must not be wasted.
sents.cn: 所有人都必定同意：这一机会绝不能浪费。

sents.en: It is neither desirable nor morally acceptable nor practical for this county to tolerate the signs of deprivation more commonly associated with the slums of Rio de Janeiro.
sents.cn: 让这个县去容忍那些通常与里约热内卢贫民窟联系在一起的贫困景象，既不可取，也不符合道德，更不现实。
我们是怎么走到这一步的？

sents.en: For as long as there are homeless people, there is a tendency to blame the victims themselves for their condition·to see their failure to thrive as an issue of character, of moral weakness, of laziness.
sents.cn: 只要有流浪者在，人们就倾向于把他们的处境归咎于受害者本人——把他们的不得志视作品格问题、道德缺陷或懒惰。

sents.en: But contrary to popular belief, the homeless in Los Angeles are not mostly mentally ill or drug addicted or frightening, although a sizable minority meet some of those descriptions.
sents.cn: 但与普遍看法相反，洛杉矶的无家可归者大多并非精神病患者、瘾君子或令人生畏之人，尽管相当一部分少数人确实符合其中某些描述。

sents.en: Today, a greater and greater proportion of people living on the streets are there because of bad luck or a series of mistakes, or because the economy forgot them·they lost a job or were evicted or fled an abusive marriage just as the housing market was growing increasingly unforgiving.
sents.cn: 如今，越来越多流落街头的人沦落至此，是因为运气不好或一连串失误，或是因为经济把他们遗忘了——就在住房市场变得越来越不容情面之际，他们失去了工作、被逐出家门，或逃离了受虐待的婚姻。

sents.en: The challenges are enormous, even if everyone is pulling in the same direction.
sents.cn: 挑战是巨大的，即便所有人都朝着同一个方向努力。

sents.en: That reality was driven home this month by a new Los Angeles Homeless Services Authority report showing that the county's homeless population is growing faster than the supply of new housing.
sents.cn: 洛杉矶无家可归者服务管理局本月发布的一份新报告让这一现实显露无遗：该县无家可归人口的增长速度超过了新建住房的供应速度。

sents.en: In the world's richest nation, homelessness on this scale should be shameful and shocking.
sents.cn: 在世界上最富裕的国家，这种规模的无家可归现象本应令人羞愧和震惊。

sents.en: But most Los Angeles residents are no longer either shocked or shamed.
sents.cn: 但大多数洛杉矶居民已经不再震惊，也不再羞愧。

sents.en: Increasingly, we are uncomfortable, annoyed, disgusted, scared or unaware.
sents.cn: 我们越来越多地感到不适、恼火、厌恶、恐惧，或者干脆视而不见。

sents.en: Compassion is being replaced by resignation.
sents.cn: 同情心正在被听天由命所取代。
